verdict: Paid social is producing leads at industry-average cost, but the local profile is under-converting given a 5-star reputation.
diagnosis: Instagram ads generated 50 leads at $158 each this period, close to industry norms, but only 80 phone calls came through Google Business Profile.

signals.headline: 50 leads at $158 each
signals.detail: Instagram spend of $7,911 produced 50 form leads this period. Cost per lead sits just above HVAC blended benchmarks.

signals.headline: 80 call clicks in 28 days
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 80 calls and 99 direction requests. Low volume given 195 reviews and a 5-star average.

signals.headline: Perfect 5-star rating, 11 new reviews
signals.detail: Reputation is a genuine asset. 11 new reviews this period keeps freshness signals strong for local ranking.

signals.headline: 639 link clicks, 0 purchases tracked
signals.detail: Pixel purchase tracking shows zero conversions. Either the pixel is misconfigured or booked jobs are not flowing back to the ad account.

signals.headline: Only 25 profile visits from Instagram
signals.detail: Organic Instagram reach hit 4,374 but drove just 25 profile visits. The account is not converting reach into interest.
